description: This file defines the AppState class, a final class annotated with @Observable, responsible for managing the application's main state and user preferences in a macOS application. It contains various properties with didSet observers for persisting user defaults, methods for applying configuration, handling voice wake settings, and synchronizing with external gateway configurations. The class also manages app lifecycle aspects like launch at login and dock icon visibility, and includes test utilities for configuration testing.

classes.name: AppState
classes.description: A singleton class managing the application's primary state, user preferences, remote configurations, and voice wake settings. It observes changes to properties and persists them, handles app lifecycle actions, and manages configuration synchronization with external sources.

methods.name: applyRemoteTokenState
methods.description: Updates the remote token state based on a new token value, adjusting internal flags to indicate if the token is unsupported or has been modified.

methods.name: applyConfigFromDisk
methods.description: Loads configuration from disk and applies configuration overrides based on the loaded data.

methods.name: applyConfigOverrides
methods.description: Updates app state based on a configuration dictionary, including setting connection mode, remote transport, URL, token, and remote target.

methods.name: syncGatewayConfigNow
methods.description: Immediately synchronizes the local configuration with the external gateway configuration file.

methods.name: startConfigWatcher
methods.description: Initializes the file watcher to monitor changes in configuration files and trigger reloads.

methods.name: triggerVoiceEars
methods.description: Activates voice ear boost for an optional duration, managing an internal task to reset the state after the timeout.

methods.name: stopVoiceEars
methods.description: Disables voice ear boost and cancels any active ear boost tasks.

methods.name: blinkOnce
methods.description: Increments an internal tick counter to trigger a visual blink in the UI.

methods.name: celebrateSend
methods.description: Increments a tick counter to trigger a send celebration in the UI.

methods.name: setVoiceWakeEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables voice wake functionality, requesting permissions if necessary.

methods.name: setTalkEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables talk mode, managing permissions and updating the associated gateway state.

methods.name: applyGlobalVoiceWakeTriggers
methods.description: Sets global voice wake triggers and disables synchronization to the gateway temporarily.

methods.name: scheduleVoiceWakeGlobalSyncIfNeeded
methods.description: Schedules a delayed update to synchronize voice wake triggers with the gateway if allowed.
